name: Marquis reagent — opiate screen
reagent: Marquis reagent: concentrated sulfuric acid with formaldehyde (NIJ Standard-0604.01 appendix A.5)
validationLine: Marquis opiate screen — colours from NIJ Standard-0604.01, not yet checked against a real reaction with this app

source.document: NIJ Standard-0604.01, Color Test Reagents/Kits for Preliminary Identification of Drugs of Abuse (US Department of Justice, National Institute of Justice, July 2000)
source.table: Table 1, reagent A.5 (Marquis), rows marked * (usual kit reagent)
rows: A.5 Diacetylmorphine HCl* CHCl3 256 Deep purplish red 7.5RP 3/10
A.5 Morphine monohydrate* CHCl3 239 Very deep reddish purple 10P 3/6
A.5 Codeine* CHCl3 225 Very dark purple 7.5P 2/4

colourConversion.munsellData: docs/references/munsell/real.dat (RIT Munsell Color Science Laboratory, renotation real.dat, illuminant C, CIE 1931 2°; exact rows, no interpolation)
colourConversion.yScale: Y x 0.975 / 100 (real.dat Y is relative to smoked MgO; 0.975 converts to the perfect diffuser, per the RIT page)
colourConversion.adaptation: Bradford, illuminant C (ASTM E308-01 via docs/references/bradford-lindbloom-excerpt.txt) to the D65 white of src/pipeline/colour.ts
colourConversion.crossCheck: colour-science 0.4.7: largest ΔE00 difference 0.005 over 22 notations

targets.label: heroin (diacetylmorphine HCl)
targets.sourceRow: A.5 Diacetylmorphine HCl* CHCl3 256 Deep purplish red 7.5RP 3/10

radiusDerivation.rule: largest ΔE00 to the neighbouring Munsell chips in real.dat (hue, chroma: hue ±2.5, value ±1, chroma ±2 as applicable; missing chips skipped) + median leave-one-out ΔE00 of 3 real photos that pass the card stage (registration photos excluded)

noColourNote: Marquis reagent is colourless before it reacts; no colour developed means NEGATIVE. The app cannot tell a colourless negative from an empty zone, so the officer must confirm the test is in the sample zone; the signed photo shows which it was.
noMatchReason: Colour matches no opiate reaction in the NIJ table

readingTime.source: NIJ Standard-0604.01 §3.3: the final color, generally formed within 1 min or 2 min, after intermediate colours have disappeared

status: Thin evidence: target colours are published Munsell notations (NIJ, 2000) converted to CIELAB, not measurements of real reactions photographed with this app; the correction-error term comes from 3 real photos (the card with an orange-red plastic cap in the zone, Nothing Phone (3a)). POSITIVE has been tested only on synthetic images. Known non-target reactions inside a POSITIVE radius (presumptive-test false positives): Chlorpromazine HCl, Propoxyphene HCl.
